title: A Wood Frog Survives With 65% Of Its Water Frozen
hook: 65% of its body water freezes, yet the wood frog survives.
closing: Freeze tolerance lets one small frog live where most vertebrates cannot.
question: Would you survive one winter there?

segments.say: The wood frog survives with 65% of its body water frozen. Most vertebrates cannot tolerate even a fraction of that.
The wood frog survives temperatures 16 degrees below freezing. Ordinary frogs cannot handle that cold.
The wood frog reaches 68 degrees north in Alaska. Freeze tolerance unlocks habitats other frogs cannot use.
